title: OpenMAP-HIE: Pathology Informed Score-based Diffusion Model for Unsupervised Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Lesion Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29322v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate localization of neonatal hypoxic--ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) lesions on apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) images is clinically important but is limited by scarce expert annotations and substantial variation in lesion appearance. We propose OpenMAP-HIE, a pathology-informed score-based diffusion model for unsupervised HIE lesion localization without voxel-wise lesion supervision. A denoising diffusion model learns the healthy neonatal ADC distribution, while a ControlNet-based conditional branch preserves patient-specific anatomy. At inference, anomaly evidence is derived directly from differences between conditional and unconditioned noise predictions at independently evaluated diffusion noise levels, avoiding dependence on a final pseudo-healthy reconstruction or sequential reverse-diffusion chain. translated_abstract: 在表观扩散系数（ADC）图像上准确定位新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）病灶具有重要的临床意义，但受限于专家标注稀缺以及病灶外观的巨大差异。我们提出OpenMAP-HIE，一种基于病理信息的分数扩散模型，可在无需体素级病灶监督的情况下实现无监督的HIE病灶定位。该模型通过去噪扩散模型学习健康新生儿的ADC分布，同时利用基于ControlNet的条件分支保留患者特定的解剖结构。在推理阶段，异常证据直接来源于条件和无条件噪声预测在独立评估的扩散噪声水平上的差异，从而避免了对最终伪健康重建或顺序反向扩散链的依赖。基于急性HIE相关的特征性ADC降低，该模型仅考虑与预期病理表现一致
tldr: 提出了基于病理信息的分数扩散模型OpenMAP-HIE，无需人工标注即可通过条件与无条件噪声预测的差异无监督地分割新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病病灶。
en_tdlr: OpenMAP-HIE, a pathology-informed score-based diffusion model, enables unsupervised segmentation of neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy lesions without manual annotations by deriving anomaly evidence directly from differences between conditional and unconditional noise predictions.
